scope_and_limits: Published public list prices captured on September 16 Pacific (September 17 UTC). Per-node CoreWeave rates were divided by eight GPUs; Modal per-second GPU-only rates were multiplied by 3600. Product bundles, terms, and included CPU/memory differ. Listed prices do not establish realized transaction prices, availability, utilization, or market-wide price direction. June-to-September matched observations are separately recorded in gpu_pricing_delta_2026-09-16.json.
